subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should the Node coordinator trust the AWS RDS CA bundle process-wide, or must RDS trust be scoped to PostgreSQL?
rationale: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS changes the trust boundary for every Node TLS connection, and neither tests nor existing repository policy establish that this broader scope is intended.

options.title: Scope trust to PostgreSQL
options.body: Configure the RDS CA only on the database connection so unrelated outbound TLS retains the system trust boundary.

options.title: Accept process-wide trust
options.body: Keep NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with explicit maintainer acceptance and documentation of the broader deployment contract.

recommendation.title: Scope trust to PostgreSQL
recommendation.body: Configure the RDS CA only on the database connection so unrelated outbound TLS retains the system trust boundary.
